description: Shipped tone profiles for Construct document and agent output. Projects override via .cx/brand-voice.json.

direct.constraints: Lead with the answer. Plain language. Never contradict rules/common/neurodivergent-output.md.

friendly.constraints: Warm but not casual. No idioms. Define terms on first use.

executive-concise.constraints: TL;DR first. One idea per paragraph. Tables for numbers.

decision-forcing-direct.constraints: Every section drives a decision or acceptance criterion. Rejected alternatives required where applicable.

blameless.constraints: Corrective actions target systems, not people. No shame language.

pedagogical.constraints: Teach the reader. Progressive disclosure. Examples before abstractions.
